verdict.rationale: Termius documents Workspaces that group multiple terminal sessions, with templates capturing per-tab names, layout, working directories and running commands. Per-connection context comes from host environment variables and startup snippets, and per-session history from automatic session logs started on every connection. Missing for 10: any documented per-session appearance or theme customization, any independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-session use, and evidence of per-session shell history isolation beyond logs.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can open multiple terminal sessions, each with its own context, appearance, and history

citations.quote: Workspaces group multiple terminal sessions into one focused environment
Workspace templates capture: Included connections, Tab names, Layout configuration, Working directories, Running commands at the time of saving
Every time you connect, a new log starts recording automatically
Environment variables let you pass `KEY=VALUE` pairs to the remote shell as part of establishing an SSH connection.
